summary: Frontend-only Playwright pass on the rewritten about.html (GSAP 3.15 + ScrollTrigger). Verified: zero console/page errors, gsap+ScrollTrigger loaded, scroll progress bar 0->100%, per-section data-theme body background + meta theme-color updates across all 12 sections, all 73 gs-* reveal elements end at opacity 1 after scroll, LEED clip-path scrub reaches inset(0 0 0%), stats count-up (10+ / Istanbul), stat divider scaleY=1, final CTA title renders as two lines, manifesto orbit SVG present and contained (section overflow:hidden, no page overflow at 390px), register form validation + reset, 4 data-scroll=register buttons, side menu open/close, index->about submenu nav, EXPLORE links, footer ABOUT NOVA -> about.html on 5 spot-checked pages, about_trust.webp & about_cta1.webp HTTP 200 and rendering. Found 1 high-priority robustness bug (page content invisible if the GSAP CDN fails), plus reduced-motion stat regression, a copy/paste-broken manifesto paragraph, and 2 design/contrast issues.

ui_bugs.component: about.js GSAP guard / about.css initial states
ui_bugs.issue: If cdn.jsdelivr.net (GSAP) is unreachable, about.js returns at line 49 BEFORE any fallback reveal, so CSS initial states stay applied: all 73 .gs-fade-up/.gs-fade-left/.gs-line/.gs-blur-up/.gs-word elements remain opacity:0 and .gs-clip-reveal stays inset(0 0 100%). Verified by aborting **cdn.jsdelivr.net** requests: the whole about page renders with blank/empty sections (only images + header/footer visible). Claim that animations 'gracefully no-op' without GSAP is not true. Fix: move the 'reveal everything' reset above the gsap check (or use a no-JS/failed-load fallback class on <html>).

Under prefers-reduced-motion:reduce (and with GSAP unavailable) the stat renders the literal HTML value '0' instead of '10+' because the reduced-motion branch returns before the count-up code and never writes the final value. Static HTML should contain '10+' (or the reduced-motion branch should set textContent = count+suffix).

Words are visually spaced only via CSS margin-right:0.28em; the real space characters were removed, so innerText/selection/copy of the manifesto paragraph is 'NovaKonutdevelopsrefined...' (verified via Selection.toString()). Bad for copy-paste, screen readers, in-page find (Ctrl+F across words) and SEO-ish text extraction. Fix: keep a real space inside/after each span (e.g. span.textContent = word + '\u00a0'? better: append document.createTextNode(' ') between spans and drop margin-right).

ScrollTrigger onToggle only fires on toggle, so on initial load (hero already active) body background stays #fff and meta theme-color stays the hardcoded #0b0b0b instead of the hero's data-theme #0a0a0a. Cosmetic only (hero is a full-bleed dark image), but the first scroll sample shows body going white->then themed. Consider applying the first section's theme on init.

'.ab-split--gray' has data-theme="#f2efe9" but its colour-breath tween starts at #f7f6f3, so the body overscroll colour and the section colour disagree slightly at section entry. Trivially inconsistent, not visually broken.

issues: The gold/olive overlay on about_cta1.webp is very heavy - the photo reads as a flat yellow wash rather than a luxury interior
Body copy 'Speak with our team about investment opportunities...' and the 'PARTNER WITH NOVA' eyebrow are light grey/white on a light gold background = low contrast, hard to read

about_trust.webp is now warm (fixed vs the old cyan image) but is extremely saturated orange, which reads off-brand next to the rest of the muted gold/cream palette - consider a lower-saturation dusk facade
White stat labels sit over the brightest part of the bridge photo; 'RESIDENTIAL PROJECTS' / 'OUR HOME MARKET' contrast is marginal - a slightly stronger scrim would help

action_items: HIGH: Reveal .gs-* elements when GSAP/ScrollTrigger fails to load (move the opacity/clip-path reset before the `if (!window.gsap...) return;` guard) - currently a CDN outage blanks the entire about page.
Set stat final values for reduced-motion / no-GSAP paths (or put '10+' in the HTML) - currently shows '0'.
Restore real space characters in splitWords() so the manifesto paragraph is copyable/searchable/screen-reader-correct.
Apply the first section's data-theme on init so body bg / meta theme-color aren't stale on load.
Design: reduce the gold overlay + raise text contrast in the Partner CTA; de-saturate about_trust.webp.
critical_code_review_comments: about.js: reduced-motion + no-GSAP fallbacks are placed after the GSAP guard, coupling content visibility to a third-party CDN - content should never depend on an animation library.
splitWords() uses el.textContent, which would silently destroy any nested markup (links/em) inside a future .gs-words element; use childNodes-aware splitting.
splitWords() forEach params (i, arr) are unused - dead args.
colorBreaths start colours are duplicated from CSS section backgrounds and from data-theme attributes (3 sources of truth for the same colour); derive from data-theme or from computed style.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth on this static site
context_for_next_testing_agent: about.html GSAP rewrite verified: 12 data-theme sections all update body bg + meta theme-color correctly on scroll, progress bar works, all reveal animations end visible, LEED clip scrub completes, stats count up to 10+, final CTA title is 2 lines, manifesto orbit SVG contained on desktop+390px mobile (no horizontal page overflow), register form validates/resets, side-menu + EXPLORE + footer ABOUT NOVA links all navigate correctly (spot-checked bahar/dogan/east-west/falcon-plaza/mercan). Outstanding: (1) CDN-failure blank-page bug, (2) reduced-motion stat '0', (3) merged words in copied text. Re-test those three by aborting **cdn.jsdelivr.net** and by emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce').
rca_of_the_issue: about.css pre-hides every animated element (opacity:0 / clip-path inset 100%) to avoid FOUC, while about.js only removes those states inside the GSAP-available code path. Any failure to load GSAP from cdn.jsdelivr.net therefore leaves the page permanently blank in those sections; likewise the reduced-motion early-return skips the stat count-up so the placeholder '0' in the HTML is never replaced.
